title: Shared event fields
description: Reusable field types for the queue events. SQS Event Contracts §3.1, Communication Standards §3.

schemaVersion.description: Major contract version. All MVP events use 1.

id.description: Opaque identifier. Never parse or derive meaning from it.

attempt.description: Retry attempt number (default 1). Request events may carry it; result and failure events echo it.

s3Key.description: Object key relative to its bucket, for example user-123/job-456/cv.pdf. No leading slash.

slug.description: Subdomain slug: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, a valid DNS label of at most 63 characters. Website Service doc.

githubUsername.description: Normalized GitHub username (GitHub allows letters, digits and single hyphens, at most 39 characters).

errorMessage.description: Short, safe to show to a user. No stack traces, CV text, personal data or secrets.
